comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for sending this in, @vndnua — the auto-generated crash reports are genuinely useful, and this one pointed straight at a real rough edge. Good news: it's fixed.

**What was happening:** when you open **View → Load Layout** and pick a saved layout, mRemoteNG closes the current panels and then re-reads the layout XML, recreating each panel it references (Connections tree, Config, Errors/Info).
